Package org.frc5411.robot2024

package org.frc5411.robot2024

robot2024

Contains implementation of working robot-code, this is the actual, season-specific implementation of the robot's mechanisms designed to work in tandem with the utilities provided within the project's lib directory.

This also serves as a place to put top-level annotations that apply to all files within the relevant sub-directories.
